entries.3d1665ff7dc20a7e: A logistics and real estate group with three subsidiaries, engaged in ocean shipping, warehousing and transportation, and real estate leasing.
entries.3f29ab55e04893a9: The business stores goods in warehouses for customers. In addition to the general warehouse business, the company holds a license for bonded storage areas and also handles storage of imported and exported cargo on which customs duties have not been paid.
entries.55b02776cf8b6e40: Lessees of residential and office properties
entries.60d57cb7136f7f9c: The business transports consigned cargo in the company's warehouses and elsewhere. The company also handles moving services.
entries.6aa33d1c53ca8491: Cargo transport through in-house vessel operation
entries.6fee331919f7295f: It operates time-chartered and other vessels in-house and transports cargo.
entries.85af54e841f184cf: Holding a certification from the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism, the business stores document boxes, fixtures and other items in warehouses.
entries.a8aa5620dc29c84d: It time-charters vessels to charterers (peer companies).
entries.ac7a8fb750933169: This is the largest business of the company group, providing cargo transport through in-house vessel operation and vessel leasing. It transports cargo using vessels time-chartered from subsidiaries or from shipowners (peer companies) and operated in-house, and also time-charters vessels to charterers (peer companies). It is the consolidated subsidiary DELICA SHIPPING S.A. that mainly time-charters vessels to the company. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥25,747 million, and the number of employees was 32 as of March 31, 2026.
entries.c71dbe73208d6d5e: Centered on the Kachidoki area, it leases residential and office properties that it owns.
entries.cd014db115d2af8c: This business leases facilities. Centered on the Kachidoki area, it leases residential and office properties that the company owns. It has operated rental properties such as the apartment buildings Plaza Kachidoki and Plaza Tower Kachidoki, and the rental office building Inui Building Kachidoki. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥3,933 million, and the number of employees as of March 31, 2026 was 5.
entries.e47cff2950a0ca65: Customers who store goods in the warehouse
entries.e6b7ef7184fbd59c: This business handles warehousing, cargo handling and freight transport. It consists of the warehousing business, which stores goods in warehouses for customers; the document storage business, which holds a certification from the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism; and the freight transport business, which transports consigned cargo in the company's warehouses and elsewhere. Consolidated subsidiaries Inui Unso Co., Ltd. and Inui Warehouse Operations Co., Ltd. handle in-warehouse work, automobile transport, moving services and other operations. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥3,955 million, and the number of employees as of March 31, 2026 was 123.
